"""Capture bound enforcement: record count and decoded/decompressed bytes."""
import base64, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
import zstandard as zstd
from common import COLUMNS
from harness import campaign, lease, run

HEADER = (','.join(COLUMNS) + '\n').encode()
ROW = b'icmp,a,0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,,\n'

def chunks(data, size=1 << 20):
    return [base64.b64encode(data[i:i + size]).decode() for i in range(0, len(data), size)]

def check(label, res, want, seconds=None):
    ok = res == want
    print('%-34s %-28s want %-22s %s%s' % (label, str(res)[:28], str(want)[:22],
                                           'OK' if ok else 'MISMATCH',
                                           '' if seconds is None else ' (%.1fs)' % seconds))

t = time.time()
data = HEADER + ROW * 200001
check('200001 records', run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], captures=[
    {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': chunks(data)}]), expect_error='capture'),
    {'error': 'capture'}, time.time() - t)

t = time.time()
data = HEADER + ROW * 200000
res = run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], captures=[
    {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': chunks(data)}]))
check('200000 records', (len(res['rejected']), res['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live']), (0, 1),
      time.time() - t)

t = time.time()
raw = HEADER + b'#' * (32 * 1024 * 1024 - len(HEADER) + 1)
check('decoded 32 MiB + 1', run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], captures=[
    {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': chunks(raw)}]), expect_error='capture'),
    {'error': 'capture'}, time.time() - t)

t = time.time()
raw = HEADER + b'#' * (32 * 1024 * 1024 - len(HEADER))
check('decoded exactly 32 MiB', run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], captures=[
    {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': chunks(raw)}]), expect_error='capture'),
    {'error': 'capture'}, time.time() - t)   # still a capture error: bad CSV header/records

t = time.time()
line = ROW * 200
body = HEADER + line * 700          # ~7.4k * 140000 = ~112 MiB decompressed
compressed = zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=19).compress(body)
print('  compressed %.2f MiB, decompressed %.1f MiB' % (len(compressed) / 1048576, len(body) / 1048576))
out = run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], captures=[
    {'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': chunks(compressed)}]))
print('  112 MiB decompressed ->', 'capture error' if out == {'error': 'capture'}
      else 'accepted (rejected=%d) %.1fs' % (len(out['rejected']), time.time() - t))

t = time.time()
body2 = HEADER + line * 900         # ~145 MiB decompressed -> over the 128 MiB budget
compressed2 = zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=19).compress(body2)
out = run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], captures=[
    {'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': chunks(compressed2)}]), expect_error='capture')
check('decompressed > 128 MiB', out, {'error': 'capture'}, time.time() - t)
PYEOF
